description: PS01 station dashboard. The live SCADA diagram and active alert list occupy the first row. Three historical trends, pump timeline and alarm event table follow below. SCADA always shows the latest values; historical panels use the selected time range. Duplicate stat panels were removed. Six alert rules link to the level/pressure trends and pump timeline.

panels.description: Detailed 3D station artwork derived from the supplied reference images, embedded in this dashboard without external dependencies. All readings, water fill, flow animation, pump tint/icons and alarms are live SVG layers. Gray pump source artwork avoids baked-in false states. Stale data and reduced-motion protections apply.

options.css: :host{color:inherit;background:transparent}svg{display:block;font-family:"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif}.flow-motion{fill:none;stroke:#e6fcff;stroke-width:4;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-dasharray:12 40;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 3px #3ee4ff);animation:flow 1.2s linear infinite;animation-play-state:paused}.flow-motion[data-moving="true"]{animation-play-state:running}.rotor{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;animation:spin 1.8s linear infinite;animation-play-state:paused}.rotor[data-moving="true"]{animation-play-state:running}.water-ripples{animation:ripple 2.6s ease-in-out infinite alternate;animation-play-state:paused}.water-ripples[data-moving="true"]{animation-play-state:running}.glass-card{filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 4px #132f4933)}.pump-tint{mix-blend-mode:color;opacity:.82}#water{transition:y 1.6s ease,height 1.6s ease}#water-surface{transition:cy 1.6s ease}#water-wave{transition:transform 1.6s ease}@keyframes flow{to{stroke-dashoffset:-52}}@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}@keyframes ripple{from{transform:translateX(-4px);opacity:.45}to{transform:translateX(4px);opacity:.9}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.flow-motion,.rotor,.water-ripples{animation:none!important}#water,#water-surface,#water-wave{transition:none}}

targets.sql: SELECT LAST_ROW(val) FROM iot_ps.telemetry WHERE tag_id = 'LT01'
SELECT LAST_ROW(val) FROM iot_ps.telemetry WHERE tag_id = 'PT01'
SELECT LAST_ROW(val) FROM iot_ps.telemetry WHERE tag_id = 'FT01'
SELECT LAST_ROW(state_code) FROM iot_ps.pump_status WHERE asset = 'P01'
SELECT LAST_ROW(state_code) FROM iot_ps.pump_status WHERE asset = 'P02'
SELECT LAST_ROW(ts) FROM iot_ps.telemetry WHERE tag_id = 'LT01'

panels.description: Shows firing, pending, recovering, error and no-data states only. Normal alerts disappear after the next evaluation and dashboard refresh. Alarm transitions above retain history.
panels.title: PS01 - Active alerts

targets.sql: SELECT ts, val AS Level FROM iot_ps.ps01_lt01 WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts, val AS Pressure FROM iot_ps.ps01_pt01 WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts, val AS Flow FROM iot_ps.ps01_ft01 WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts, state_code AS P01 FROM iot_ps.ps01_p01_status WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts, state_code AS P02 FROM iot_ps.ps01_p02_status WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts, alarm_code, severity, is_active, tag_id, val, thr FROM iot_ps.alarm_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100
